glosses: masculine singular passive adjectival participle of rozkojarzyć
zachowujący się lub myślący chaotycznie, nie mogący się skupić

examples.text: Chyba był trochę rozkojarzony. Czyżby to przez fakt, że za dużo myślał o pewnej przedszkolance?

glosses: having one's attention diverted; preoccupied; distrait (literary)

examples.text: Plenty of accidents happened with a look-out present but momentarily distracted.
Runs about the house like a distracted person crying and making a most hideous noise.
There'll be a procession— bands— dead march— bells tolling— all the girls in tears— Yum-Yum distracted— then, when it's all over, general rejoicings, and a display of fireworks in the evening.

glosses: simple past and past participle of distract
Absent in mind; often preoccupied; forgetful or careless due to distraction; easily distracted.

examples.text: It took the absent-minded man twenty minutes to find his glasses on top of his head.
His figure was bent in apologetic protest. "I ask a thousand pardons, sir," he said; "I am really so very absent-minded."
